name: HITEAM
description_en:
HITEAM presents a product and engineering planning workspace built around automated estimates, multi-team roadmaps and parallel releases. Its scope extends to supporting knowledge, risks, customer onboarding and other cross-functional work, rather than only general-purpose team chat.

The public material describes intended planning outcomes more clearly than the estimation algorithm, permission model or import/export procedure. This draft therefore separates advertised modules from a proposed evaluation and preserves the launch offer’s registration condition. A forecast date is not treated as a delivery guarantee, and modules explicitly marked Coming Soon are not presented as released.
description_zh:
HITEAM 将自己定位为产品及工程规划工作区，围绕自动估算、多团队路线图及并行发布组织工作，并延伸到知识、风险、客户入驻等跨职能支持，而非只有通用团队聊天。

公开资料对预期规划效果的描述，比估算算法、权限模型或导入／导出程序更明确。因此，本稿区分宣传模块与拟议评估，并保留启动优惠的注册条件。预测日期不视为交付保证，明确标为 Coming Soon 的模块不作为已发布功能。

core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商描述生成估算及交付日期，校准细节未核实。

core_features.explanation_zh: 文档面向多个 Scrum 团队描述路线图及并行发布跟踪。

core_features.explanation_en: Knowledge, risks and support are described alongside planning, with explicit roadmap exclusions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 规划之外还描述知识、风险及支持，并保留明确的待推出排除项。

en: Challenge a cross-team release estimate with an urgent defect and a blocked dependency.
zh: 用紧急缺陷及阻塞依赖检验跨团队发布估算。

sections.title_en: Evaluate a product plan across teams and work types
sections.title_zh: 跨团队及工作类型评估产品计划
sections.en: The current home distinguishes defects, enhancements and new features within a multi-track planning proposition. That makes a mixed backlog a more useful starting point than a single uniform task list. HITEAM also positions itself for product managers, engineering leadership and Scrum coordination across distributed teams. These are vendor-described audiences and intended jobs; the public claims do not establish an independently measured reduction in meetings, accurate forecasts or on-time delivery.
sections.zh: 当前主页在多轨规划中区分缺陷、增强及新功能。因此，相比单一类型任务清单，混合待办更适合作为评估起点。HITEAM 还面向分布式团队中的产品经理、工程负责人及 Scrum 协调。这些属于厂商描述的受众及拟解决任务，公开主张未确立经独立测量的会议减少、预测准确或准时交付。

sections.title_en: Use a changed dependency to challenge the forecast
sections.en:
In a proposed evaluation, choose one enhancement spanning two teams and one urgent defect competing for capacity. Record the initial plan, introduce a blocked dependency, then inspect whether the revised estimate and release view explain the change. Preserve the underlying assumptions rather than promising the generated date to a customer.

The method page describes automation of story sizing, estimation and iterative planning, but does not establish the required history, model, units, confidence intervals, capacity calendar or treatment of scope changes. This is an evaluation design, not a demonstrated sequence of product clicks or a measured result. The public demo landing supplied an introduction; its video was not watched.
sections.zh:
拟议评估可选择一项横跨两个团队的增强，以及一项争用产能的紧急缺陷。记录初始计划，引入阻塞依赖，再检查修订后的估算及发布视图能否解释变化。应保留底层假设，不宜把生成日期直接承诺给客户。

方法页描述自动进行故事规模、估算及迭代规划，但未确立所需历史、模型、单位、置信区间、产能日历或范围变更处理。这是评估设计，不是已演示的产品点击顺序或测得结果。公开演示页只返回介绍，其视频未观看。

sections.title_en: Separate planning modules from announced capabilities
sections.title_zh: 区分规划模块与已宣布能力
sections.en:
Roadmap is described for multi-team planning, ReleaseTrain for parallel releases and Support for routing issues toward Scrum teams. Knowledge and RisksTrack provide supporting context; these descriptions do not prove a dependency execution engine, deployment system or incident-response service.

The product page explicitly marks DesignBench and TeamHealth as Coming Soon, despite their appearance in the home/pricing feature lists. Do not assume roadmap-to-story allocation or the described anonymous morale heatmap is available. Nor does a future self-report heatmap establish anonymity at a particular team size or objective employee productivity. Check the actual released module and entitlement before using it in a live process.
sections.zh:
Roadmap 被描述为多团队规划，ReleaseTrain 为并行发布，Support 为将问题分配给 Scrum 团队；Knowledge 与 RisksTrack 提供支持信息。这些描述不证明存在依赖执行引擎、部署系统或事故响应服务。

产品页明确把 DesignBench、TeamHealth 标为 Coming Soon，尽管它们出现在主页／价格功能清单。不能假定路线图拆解分配或所述匿名士气热图已可用；未来的自报热图也不证明特定团队规模下的匿名性或客观员工生产力。真实流程使用前应检查已发布模块及资格。

sections.title_en: A free license offer still has an eligibility boundary
sections.title_zh: 免费许可证优惠仍有资格边界
sections.en:
The pricing page advertises a Community Edition for up to 100 users, unlimited teams and all features at $0 with no card. It limits the 100-user offer to the first 1,000 registrations. The displayed claimed count is not live inventory verification, so do not turn it into a guaranteed remaining allocation. Terms that promise a free version do not settle what happens after the promotion or beyond 100 users; no paid rate, storage quota or continuation condition was established.

Registration asks for a business email, password, time zone and terms acceptance. Reading that form does not prove email verification, tenant creation, team invitations or success with an existing backlog. No registration or purchase was performed.
sections.zh:
价格页宣传 Community Edition：最多100名用户、无限团队、全部功能、$0，且无需银行卡；同时把100用户优惠限定为前1,000个注册。显示的已领取数量不是实时库存核验，不能转成剩余名额保证。免费版本条款也不确定优惠结束或超过100用户后的条件；未确立付费价格、存储配额及持续资格。

注册要求业务邮箱、密码、时区及接受条款。读取表单不证明邮箱验证、租户创建、团队邀请或已有待办能成功导入。本研究未执行注册或购买。

sections.title_en: Obtain an exit copy before cancelling
sections.title_zh: 取消前先取得退出副本
sections.en:
Terms say cancellation immediately removes content access, with active-system/log deletion within 30 days and backup deletion within 60 days. Those retention periods are not promised recovery windows. Use the product’s cancellation path; an email or phone request is not automatically cancellation. Unused time is not automatically prorated. A failed paid trial can freeze access and eventually lead to cancellation, without a precise freeze-to-deletion interval established here.

The terms retain customer content ownership while restricting reuse of application code/design. The CC BY attribution concerns adapted policy text, not an open-source HITEAM application. A generic API clause mentioning other named products does not establish working HITEAM connectors. Export/restore, scoped permissions, API authentication and operational support response were not verified.
sections.zh:
条款称取消会立即移除内容访问，三十天内从活动系统／日志删除，六十天内从备份删除；这些保留期限不是承诺的恢复窗口。应使用产品取消路径，邮件或电话请求不会自动构成取消，未使用时间不自动按比例退款。付费试用未付款可冻结访问并最终取消，此处未确立冻结至删除的准确时序。

条款保留客户内容所有权，同时限制应用代码／设计复用。CC BY 署名涉及改写的政策文字，不是开源 HITEAM 应用。通用 API 条款列出其他产品名，也不确立可工作的 HITEAM 连接器。导出／恢复、分级权限、API 认证及实际支持响应未核实。

sections.title_en: Adopt only the planning behavior you can actually observe
sections.title_zh: 只采用能够实际观察的规划行为
sections.en:
Consider HITEAM when the immediate question is how a changing backlog affects several engineering teams and releases. A single small planning exercise can reveal whether the estimate is explainable and the actual workflow fits the team. It is a weaker choice for a requirement that already depends on verified regulatory controls, deterministic forecasting or a proven migration/rollback process: this documentation review did not establish those conditions.

Before placing real work in it, confirm the free-license entitlement, released modules, who can see/edit each project, and how to retrieve records independently. No project, backlog, estimate, team-health submission, integration or cancellation was executed, and the public source limitations remain visible rather than being filled with generic agile advice.
sections.zh:
当眼前问题是待办变化如何影响多个工程团队和发布时，可考虑 HITEAM。一个小型规划练习可揭示估算是否可解释、真实流程是否适合团队。若要求已经依赖核实过的监管控制、确定性预测或经证明的迁移／回滚，则本次文档研究未确立这些条件。

放入真实工作前，应确认免费许可资格、已发布模块、各项目查看／编辑人员，以及独立取回记录的方法。本研究未执行项目、待办、估算、团队健康提交、集成或取消，公开来源的限制保持可见，不用通用敏捷建议补齐。
